checks.detail: 16/16 reached; unions (all bots): lantern_festival 1, heavens_toll 1, lanternfall 8

notes: M4 gates: no weapon over 60% damage share; every evolution and union reached by the skilled bot at least once in 200 runs.
Skilled bot fix in M4 (own commit): reliquaries are pursued at any range, accepting up to 3 predicted contacts when above half HP; before this it never collected one (0 per run).
Oil-Paper Parasol and Salt Circle deal little damage by design (crowd control / projectile blocking, which matters once M5 adds enemy shots).
Rescored after narrowing the evolution gate to evolutions (as the plan specifies); unions are rare secrets and are reported in the check detail.
